title: 第二十章我也要接
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
“这破任务，除了咱们王师兄谁他妈的敢接！这真是给锻体境弟子的任务？一般的凝气怕是连门都摸不着吧！”

    络腮胡这一嗓子喊出去，旁边不少人都凑了过来。

    任务大厅本来就热闹，这下更热闹了。

    血色木牌挂在一堆白牌上头，实在扎眼。别的任务写的是采药、送信、护送，顶多麻烦点。

    它不一样，它光摆在那儿，就透着一股谁碰谁倒霉的味儿。

    叶凡混在人群后头，顺着缝隙往前挤。

    他现在这张脸已经不是先前那副快进棺材的老样子了，皮肉结实，头发乌黑，穿着洗白了的外门青衣。

    除了寒酸点，跟普通外门弟子没多大区别。

    一路走来，根本没人把他和废阁那个老杂役联想到一块去。

    这倒省了他不少事。

    “让让，挡着了。”

    前面一个瘦高弟子被挤得不乐意，回头瞪了眼。

    一看是个面生的锻体四阶，脸上那点不耐烦直接摆出来了。

    “你挤什么挤？”

    “看热闹也得掂量掂量自己吧？这任务跟你有半块灵石关系吗？”

    旁边几个人也跟着乐。

    “还真是，四阶也敢往前凑。”

    “兄弟，白牌最底下那排有挑水送药的活儿，你去看那个，那个适合你。”

    “哈哈哈哈，血色悬赏你也想瞄一眼？胆子不小，命更大啊。”

    叶凡被堵在外头，没急。

    他咧嘴笑了笑，往旁边挪了半步。

    “几位师兄别上火，我就看看。”

    “看看也不行？”

    那瘦高弟子哼了一声。

    “不是不行，是怕你看完脑子一热，真跑去接。到时候死在外面，宗门还得给你收尸，多麻烦。”

    叶凡点点头，跟真听进去了一样。

    “有道理。”

    “不过我这种穷人，平时也接不到什么大活，好不容易看见红的，想长长见识。”

    这话一出，周围又是一阵笑。

    有人拍着大腿。

    “你这话还真没毛病，穷人就该多看看，省得死前没见过世面。”

    “让他看吧，看看又不会少块肉。”

    前头几人挪了挪，叶凡总算站到了能看清木牌的位置。

    血色木牌上写得很干脆，字也不多。

    任务：捕获异化雷火玄鸡一只，须活捉。

    时限：三日内。

    地点：宗门南面百里，雷劫地。

    要求：仅限锻体境弟子接取。

    奖励：下品灵石五十块，外加入品符箓一张，养元丹三瓶。

    下面还补了一句。

    若能多抓一只，每只另加二十块下品灵石。

    叶凡盯着那奖励，眼皮都跳了一下。

    五十块下品灵石。

    这已经不是普通外门弟子能轻松碰到的数目了。

    再加避雷符和养元丹，这价码摆出来，难怪挂成红色。

    大厅里不少弟子盯着木牌吞口水，可真上前摘牌的，一个都没有。

    原因也简单。

    红榜奖励越高，坑越大。

    叶凡往下又看了一遍，眉头却慢慢松开了些。

    异化雷火玄鸡？

    这玩意他熟。

    太熟了。

    当年还在杂役院的时候，灵兽房人手不够，他被抓去顶过几个月的活。

    喂过鸡，扫过粪，挨过啄，还差点让一只脾气暴的公鸡抓瞎过眼。

    雷火玄鸡不算正经灵兽，连入品都够不上，真要说，也就是比普通家禽凶点。

    个头大一圈，肉里带些雷火气，炖出来挺补。

    嘴硬，爪子利，跑得快，扑起来也猛。
content_en:
"Who the hell dares to take on this ridiculous task except our Senior Brother Wang! Is this really a task for the disciples of the Forging Realm? Ordinary Qi Condensation can't even touch the door!"

    The bearded man shouted, and many people nearby came over.

    The mission hall was already lively, but it was even more lively now.

    The bloody wooden sign hung on top of a pile of white signs was really eye-catching. Other tasks are about collecting herbs, delivering letters, and escorting, which are a bit troublesome at best.

    It was different. Just by putting it there, it gave off a smell that meant whoever touched it would be unlucky.

    Ye Fan mingled behind the crowd and squeezed forward along the gap.

    His current face is no longer the same as before, as he was about to be put into a coffin. He has strong skin, black hair, and is wearing white-washed Tsing Yi.

    Apart from being a bit shabby, he is not much different from ordinary outer disciples.

    Along the way, no one associated him with the old handyman from Feige.

    This saved him a lot of trouble.

    "Let's get in the way."

    The tall and thin disciple in front was unhappy with being squeezed, so he turned back and glared.

    At first glance, he looked like an unfamiliar fourth-level bodybuilder, and his impatience was clearly visible on his face.

    "Why are you squeezing?"

    "Watching the fun, you have to think about yourself, right? Does this mission have anything to do with you having half a spirit stone?"

    Several people nearby also joined in the fun.

    "It's true, even the fourth level dares to move forward."

    "Brother, the row at the bottom of the white card has jobs for carrying water and delivering medicine. Go check out that one. That one is suitable for you."

    "Hahahaha, do you want to take a look at the bloody bounty? If you are brave, you will be more lucky."

    Ye Fan was blocked outside and was in no hurry.

    He grinned and took a half step to the side.

    "Senior brothers, please don't get angry. I'll just take a look."

    "Can't you just take a look?"

    The tall and thin disciple snorted.

    "It's not that it's impossible, I'm afraid that after reading this, your brain will get hot and you will run to pick her up. If you die outside, the sect will have to collect your body, which will be very troublesome."

    Ye Fan nodded, as if he really listened.

    "That makes sense."

    "But as a poor person like me, I usually don't get any big jobs. I finally saw the red ones and wanted to learn more about them."

    As soon as these words came out, there was another round of laughter.

    Someone patted his thigh.

    "There's nothing wrong with what you said. Poor people should see more of it so that they don't die without seeing the world."

    "Let him see it, and see if there is no missing piece of meat."

    The first few people moved, and Ye Fan finally stood where he could see the wooden sign clearly.

    The writing on the blood-colored wooden sign was very simple, with not many words.

    Mission: Capture an alienated thunder-fire black chicken, which must be captured alive.

    Time limit: within three days.

    Location: A hundred miles south of the sect, in the land of Thunder Tribulation.

    Requirements: Only body-forging realm disciples can receive it.

    Reward: Fifty pieces of low-grade spiritual stones, plus a high-grade talisman and three bottles of Yuan Yang Dan.

    I added a sentence below.

    If you can catch one more, twenty additional low-grade spiritual stones will be added to each.

    Ye Fan stared at the reward, his eyelids twitching.

    Fifty low-grade spiritual stones.

    This is no longer a number that ordinary outer disciples can encounter easily.

    Add in the Lightning Protection Talisman and the Yangyuan Pill, and with the price, it’s no wonder it’s hung in red.

    Many disciples in the hall stared at the wooden plaques and swallowed their saliva, but not one of them actually stepped forward to remove the plaques.

    The reason is simple.

    The higher the red list reward, the bigger the pit.

    Ye Fan looked down again, but his brows slowly relaxed.

    Alienated Thunder Fire Black Chicken?

    He is familiar with this stuff.

    Too ripe.

    When he was still in the handyman's yard, there were not enough manpower in the spirit animal room, so he was arrested and had to work for a few months.

    I have fed chickens, swept away manure, been pecked, and was almost blinded by a bad-tempered rooster.

    The Thunder Fire Black Chicken is not considered a serious spiritual beast, not even a top-grade beast. To be honest, it is a bit more ferocious than ordinary poultry.

    It's a bit bigger in size and has a bit of thunderous flavor in the meat, which makes it very nourishing when stewed.

    It has a tough mouth and sharp claws. It can run fast and pounce fiercely.
title_en: Chapter 20 I want to take it too
